notes.title: New game announcement: Castlebound!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce our next big project

[b]Castlebound is a fast-paced action Roguelike with a twist![/b]

[previewyoutube=W2vNQrAlxTc;full][/previewyoutube]
Lead a band of up to 4 heroes in an unique action platforming style and fight hordes of evil monsters!

Game Features

[list]
[*] Fast-Paced Combat: Jump, dodge, and unleash devastating attacks to fend off relentless enemy hordes!
[*] Defend the Walking Castle: Protect your fortress as it moves through dangerous lands!
[*] Solo or Co-Op Action: Take on the challenge alone or team up with a friend for an epic multiplayer adventure!
[*] Multiple Playable Heroes: Fight alongside different warriors, each with unique abilities and playstyles that offer a fresh and dynamic experience!
[*] Roguelike Progression: Each run is unique, unlock new skills, heroes, and upgrades to enhance your chances of survival!
[*] A Unique Take on the Genre: Experience an innovative blend of castle defense and roguelike combat like never before!
[/list]

The battle for the kingdom begins now—will you rise to the challenge?

You can wishlist now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/

Steve
Ogre Pixel
2025

notes.title: Support on Kickstarter our new game about stickers: A Tiny Sticker Tale
notes.content:
Hi! Any of you may know that our game [b]Lonesome Village[/b] was created thanks to all the backers who supported the game on Kickstarter.

Now, we have a new Kickstarter campaign for a new game titled [b]A Tiny Sticker Tale[/b]!

[i]Our game is a tiny and relaxing adventure where you can modify your environment with the power of stickers![/i]

[previewyoutube=jPHc46jJ5_E;full][/previewyoutube]

Our team is working hard to create a fun and captivating experience that combines the joy of gaming with the creativity of collecting and sticking stickers.

Now we need your support to make A Tiny Sticker Tale a reality ❤️. With your contribution, we can bring this incredible game to more people and enhance the experience. Every little help counts, whether you choose a basic level or an elite one.

Join us on this exciting sticky adventure. Visit our [b]Kickstarter page[/b] and discover the amazing rewards we have for you:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ogrepixel/a-tiny-sticker-tale][b]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ogrepixel/a-tiny-sticker-tale[/b][/url]

notes.title: Steam Deck compatible
notes.content:
Hi!

We are happy to share that Lonesome Village issues found in Steam Deck (mostly while trying to play an animated cutscene) have been fixed.

Weeks ago we launched a Linux version of Lonesome Village and this allowed the game to solve issues it had with Steam Deck.

Lonesome Village hasn't been verified for Steam Deck by Valve, but we know the game can now be played on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/884cd1f0095f8ffd48acf9c5847e80f4e420b8f9.png[/img]

Greetings! 

Ogre Pixel
